verdict.reason: No clean entry is available right now. USD/JPY broke above 158.35 with displacement and follow-through, but price hasn't retested the level yet. USD/CAD broke above 1.3975 and retested it around 5:00am PT, before the 6:00am window, and has since moved about 16 pips away, so that entry is gone. AUD/USD's break failed, and GBP/USD and EUR/USD only wicked at their levels. USD JOLTS (7:00am PT) is out, so USD pairs can requalify. EUR/GBP is not one of the 7 majors, so it's not graded.
